workflows.name: Fast code change with quality gates
workflows.description: Short feedback loop for a bounded code change: understand, implement, test, review, then merge through a PR.

stages.title: Inspect repository, branch, and existing tests
stages.gate: Read current state before editing.

stages.title: Check current API/library documentation
stages.gate: Use versions already pinned by the project.

stages.title: Implement one scoped change on a feature branch
stages.gate: Keep authoritative game state, wallet, ledger, auth, payments, and anti-cheat unchanged unless required.

stages.title: Add or update regression tests and debug failures
stages.gate: Do not accept untested behaviour changes.

stages.title: Run repository CI and inspect every failed job
stages.gate: Required tests and security checks must pass.

stages.title: Review diff and open/update a pull request
stages.gate: No direct production deployment from an unreviewed change.

workflows.name: LudoMada gameplay and Android QA
workflows.description: Protect game rules and verify that changes behave in the real Android renderer and gameplay runtime.

stages.title: Review rules and authoritative state boundaries
stages.gate: Preserve sortie-on-six, exact finish, capture, extra-turn, turn order, reconciliation and anti-cheat.

stages.title: Run rules, animation-guard, and regression tests
stages.gate: No test failures or unexplained skips.

stages.title: Check any changed 3D assets and file formats
stages.gate: Check GLB transforms, scale, materials, texture references, and licensing/source.

stages.title: Build on the authorized remote runner
stages.gate: Capture build command, commit SHA, exit code, and logs.

stages.title: Verify gameplay and rendering on the target Android environment
stages.gate: Check dice and pawn input guards, turn flow, captures, shadows/reflections, crashes, and performance.

stages.title: Run code security checks
stages.gate: Record scan status and investigate findings; this does not replace runtime diagnostics.

stages.title: Human release approval
stages.gate: Release only after all evidence is reviewed.

workflows.name: 3D asset creation to in-game verification
workflows.description: Keep visual generation separate from production asset integration and validate the result in the actual GLES renderer.

stages.title: Create visual references or texture concepts when useful
stages.gate: References are not treated as production meshes.

stages.title: Create/edit Blender scene and import/export GLB
stages.gate: Keep scene revision and export artifacts traceable.

stages.title: Store assets and integration changes in a feature branch
stages.gate: Record source, license, dimensions, texture dependencies, and commit SHA.

stages.title: Integrate assets into the existing renderer
stages.gate: Do not create a disconnected demo scene instead of integrating the live app.

stages.title: Validate materials, lighting, frame cost, and gameplay interaction
stages.gate: Return screenshots/logs and verify the exported asset in the target renderer.

workflows.name: Fast web deployment with staged promotion
workflows.description: Automate safe preview deployment and keep production promotion explicit.

stages.title: Run tests, secret scan, and dependency checks
stages.gate: Stop on any failed required check.

stages.title: Deploy preview and inspect deployment logs
stages.gate: Use preview/staging before production.

stages.title: Inspect post-deploy errors and events
stages.gate: If observability is not connected, record this as blocked rather than claiming verified.

stages.title: Approve production promotion
stages.gate: No unreviewed production promotion.

workflows.name: Backend and database deployment
workflows.description: Run database safety checks, deploy a staging service, validate health, and require approval before production.

stages.title: Review migrations, RLS, and data safety
stages.gate: Review migration impact and preserve wallet/ledger invariants.

stages.title: Run backend tests and security checks
stages.gate: Idempotency, auth, transaction atomicity, and provider gates must pass.

stages.title: Deploy backend staging and inspect logs
stages.gate: Health checks must pass before continuing.

stages.title: Inspect runtime errors and metrics
stages.gate: Do not mark monitoring as verified when the integration is disconnected.

stages.title: Approve production deploy/migration
stages.gate: Explicit human approval required.
